# 3. Orders

[Back to How to play](README.md)

The squad leader tasks one member, several members, or the whole team. Orders are tasking only: they never carry firing data.

## Sending an order (iPad)

1. **Who:** tap names, roster rows or dots on the map. Picking nobody sends to the whole team.
2. **What:** tap a kind. Picking a kind doesn't send anything yet.
3. **Where:** for orders that take a place, tap the map. Picking a kind always clears the old place, so a location never carries over from the last order.
4. **Note and send:** add an optional note of up to 140 characters, then **Send**.

Below the composer, each order shows every recipient's answer: **seen**, **done**, **can't**, or no answer yet.

## The orders

| Order | Icon (SF Symbol) | Takes a place | Seen opens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Range the pole | `scope` | yes | the ranging screen |
| Spot | `eye.fill` |  | the spotter card |
| Move to | `figure.walk` | yes | Go there (pointer and map), when it has a place |
| Capture | `camera.fill` | yes | Go there (pointer and map), when it has a place |
| Hold position | `hand.raised.fill` |  | Go there (pointer and map), when it has a place |
| Back to the firing point | `arrow.uturn.backward` |  | Go there (pointer and map), when it has a place |
| Note | `text.bubble.fill` |  | nothing (read it and answer) |

## On the phone

- New orders appear as a banner along the bottom of any screen, and in Join squad. The phone buzzes, and posts a notification if it's locked.
- Each order with a place shows a **pointer** that turns with the phone, the distance, and a small map.
- **Seen** tells the commander you have it, and opens the tool the order needs. **Done** or **Can't** takes the order off your list.
- Back steps between orders, so you can walk to one place, then range from another.

## Spotting

The gunner (or the commander) calls **Fired**. Every member's phone then shows the **spotter card**: tap **Short**, **Over**, **Range correct** for that round. The commander sees the calls arrive and records one.
